description: Mesh a polygon into cells (triangles / quads) — a pure CALCULATION node: coordinates in, coordinates out. Draws nothing on canvas.
instructions:
A value-only node: it takes a polygon as a coordinate LIST and returns its mesh cells as a coordinate list. It has no geometry input or output and draws nothing on the canvas — wire val-polygons into a Polygon node when you want the cells drawn.

INPUT: polygon takes the outline as JSON [[x,y],...] metre pairs, local to the anchor. Wire Space Geometry val-points into valin-polygon.

OUTPUT: val-polygons publishes every cell as a nested [[[x,y],...],...] list, which a Polygon node accepts directly.

type selects the meshing scheme. Every parameter is wireable (valin-*).
